title: communication-plan template variables
description: Values for templates/communication-plan.md.j2 and templates/communication-plan.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from communication-plan.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

last_sent_date.title: Last sent date
last_sent_date.description: When was the last one sent, as YYYY-MM-DD? This column is the whole point of the table - it is what shows a cadence that has quietly lapsed.

owner_full_name.description: Who actually sends that communication? One named human; an unowned cadence is the one that silently stops.

project_name.description: Which project does this communication plan belong to? Use the name the stakeholder register uses, so the two documents can be read side by side.

stakeholder_name.title: Stakeholder name
stakeholder_name.description: Which stakeholder does the first row cover? One row per named person - a row addressed to a department is a row nobody reads.
